title: 听力挑战 · 翻译实践讨论

rounds.speaker: 学生
rounds.line: When translating long sentences, we should divide them into clauses and rearrange their order according to Chinese habits.
rounds.lineCn: 翻译长句时,我们应该把它们切分成从句,并按中文习惯调整语序。

grammar.name: 长句拆译法
grammar.note: 英译汉先断句再调序:把 when 从句与主句分开,按中文习惯重新排列语序。

options.text: Long sentences should be split and their order adjusted for Chinese.
options.feedback: 先切分长句,再按中文习惯调整语序。

options.text: Long sentences should be translated word by word.
options.feedback: 逐词硬译不符合中文习惯,原文提倡切分和调序。

options.text: Chinese translation must keep the English word order exactly.
options.feedback: 原文明确说要按中文习惯调整语序。

rounds.speaker: 辅导老师
rounds.line: Passive voice in English often becomes active voice in Chinese to sound more natural.
rounds.lineCn: 英语中的被动语态译成中文时常转为主动语态,这样读起来更自然。

grammar.name: 语态转换
grammar.note: 英语多用被动,汉语多用主动,翻译时需灵活转换语态以求自然。

options.text: English passive sentences are often turned into active ones in Chinese.
options.feedback: 英语被动在中文中常转为主动以符合表达习惯。

options.text: English passive sentences must stay passive in Chinese.
options.feedback: 老师说的是常转为主动,而非必须保留被动。

options.text: Chinese never uses active voice at all.
options.feedback: 中文恰恰常用主动语态。

rounds.speaker: 学生
rounds.line: The difficulty lies in the term culture shock, which has no exact equivalent in our language.
rounds.lineCn: 难点在于 culture shock 这个术语,在我们语言中找不到完全对等的说法。

grammar.name: 非限制性定语从句补充说明
grammar.note: which has no exact equivalent 是对 culture shock 的补充说明,处理时可拆成单独一句。

options.text: The term culture shock lacks a precise equivalent in Chinese.
options.feedback: 该术语在目标语言中缺少完全对等的表达。

options.text: The term culture shock is easy to translate directly.
options.feedback: 原文说找不到完全对等的说法,并非容易翻译。

options.text: The term culture shock appears only in oral English.
options.feedback: 原文并未限定该词只用于口语。

rounds.speaker: 辅导老师
rounds.line: A good translation should convey the original meaning while keeping the style of the source text.
rounds.lineCn: 好的译文应传达原文意思,同时保留原文的风格。

grammar.name: while + 现在分词伴随状语
grammar.note: while keeping 表同时进行的动作,翻译时译成同时/兼顾,保持意与形并重。

options.text: A good translation preserves both meaning and style.
options.feedback: 好译文既传达意思又保留风格。

options.text: Only the grammar of the source text matters in translation.
options.feedback: 除语法外,意思和风格同样重要。

options.text: Translation should ignore the original style completely.
options.feedback: 原文明确要求保留原文风格。
